question: A cuboidal water purifier can carry 10 litres of water. Its breadth is (1)/(5) of its height and length is (1)/(3) of the sum of the breadth and height. The height of the tank is:
solution:
**Given:**

A cuboidal water purifier can carry 10 litres of water. Its breadth is (1)/(5) of its height and length is (1)/(3) of the sum of the breadth and height.

**Formula used:**

Volume of cuboid = length × breadth × height

1 litre = 1000 cm³

**Calculations:**

Volume = 10 litres = 10 × 1000 cm³ = 10000 cm³

Let height = h cm

Breadth = (1/5)h cm

Length = (1/3)(h + (1/5)h) cm

⇒ Length = (1/3)(6h/5) cm

⇒ Length = 2h/5 cm

Volume = length × breadth × height

⇒ 10000 = (2h/5) × (h/5) × h

⇒ 10000 = (2h³)/(25)

⇒ 10000 × 25 = 2h³

⇒ 250000 = 2h³

⇒ h³ = 125000

⇒ h = ∛125000

⇒ h = 50 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
